ops.entry: WHEN certifying a printed shell command as copy-runnable DO include an embedded newline in a dynamic fixture value and test the literal physical line a reader would copy — whole-command argv round-tripping can pass while the printed line splits or a value looks like a separate instruction.
ops.why: U1 adds a physical-line probe missing from O-10 (operator outcome), G-14 (source search) and O-08 (exact prior repro). Displaces a narrower generated-HTML heuristic retained in harness repository Patterns and covered generally by the changed-object census.

ops.entry: WHEN a printed remedy command selects a target DO copy-run it against a disposable intended target with a matching decoy at the default destination; verify which target was read or changed and that the decoy was untouched. Exit status alone cannot distinguish successful misrouting.
ops.why: The c2 decoy made a successful operation on the wrong target detectable, more specific than general pre-signature literal execution or O-08. Displaces markdown-specific scope guidance already substantially covered by the changed-object census and direct contract checks.

originals.original: WHEN a file-extension census surfaces HTML matches DO check each for a regeneration/do-not-edit footer before counting it in-scope — a generated ship-review or report view is not product UI, and a census alone would falsely score it in-scope.

WHEN deciding if a markdown file is in scope DO test whether it specifies spacing, colour, states, or interaction for a rendered surface — markdown is a medium this role can audit, not a guarantee any given markdown file is a UI contract.
